_meta.notes: Hardcoded Anglican/Sarum-flavored defaults for the 20-psalm fixture set. Ps 95 takes Tone 5 (traditional invitatory); Ps 114/115 take Peregrinus (the 'wandering tone'). Everything else defaults to Tone 1. Tone IDs match the actual `id` field inside each tone JSON (e.g. `tone-peregrinus`, not `tone-p`). Refine when more tones land or when PsalmToneAssignment.source preference cascade is wired (Phase 4).
